Bottom right: radiant portrait with smooth thick finished hair.

prompt_instructions: Attach exact packaging reference for readable brand fidelity.
Do not use one person’s likeness without permission.
Show healthy realistic hair texture, never plastic or exaggerated volume.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: 2x2 grid beauty campaign image showcasing the Nanogen shampoo for women (purple tube) as the hero product, combined with an elegant hair-care routine featuring a beautiful adult woman. Grid layout (four panels): Top-left – CLEANSE Close-up of the woman in the shower, water droplets on skin and hair, holding the Nanogen shampoo tube near her shoulder. Soft, dewy skin, wet hair, minimal makeup. Clean, fresh, luxurious feel. Top-right – CONDITION / MASSAGE Detailed close-up of conditioner or shampoo being worked through wet hair using fingers or a comb. Creamy texture visible on dark hair strands. Focus on nourishment, thickness, and scalp care. Neutral studio background. Bottom-left – RINSE Woman gently pressing a white towel to wet hair, eyes closed, calm and relaxed expression. Natural beauty, healthy skin tones, spa-like atmosphere. Bottom-right – RESULTS Final result portrait: the woman with smooth, thick, glossy, healthy-looking hair, softly styled and flowing naturally. Clean white or light neutral background. Confident, radiant expression. The Nanogen shampoo tube appears clearly branded, readable, and consistent across frames. High-end beauty advertising aesthetic, editorial lighting, soft shadows, premium skincare look.
